approach: Keep the round-3 design: one records-root selector in athena-data paths.rs (state dir from git's common dir; worktree <state>/records-worktree used only when it is a checkout of athena/records, else in-tree). Records::load_current and RecordSet::load_current use the worktree tip when present, else delegate to the unchanged load. Switch the 'current' callers in the deliverable files. Revision: walltime tests live in xtask's own tests (not the athena-cli file); land_pr tests live in gh.rs using Rig/FakeHost with distinct job ids; status, audit and forecast are run as the built binary with distinct ids matched in output. The common-dir derivation is new code added with the move, not a repair.

decisions.choice: Gate on worktree presence; fall back to the passed head via the unchanged Records::load path.
decisions.reason: Pre-cutover repos and scratch checkouts behave as before.

rejected.why: Breaks repos before cutover; cannot show worktree vs in-tree.
Historical treeish callers must keep their meaning.

decisions.choice: Derive state dir and git dir once in paths.rs from git --git-common-dir; backtest.rs and walltime.rs call it. This is new code added with the move, not a repair of existing code (this snapshot has no <root>/.git join in them).
decisions.reason: A linked checkout has .git as a file; the common dir is correct for both layouts. One helper serves all readers.

rejected.why: Leaves other readers without the helper.

decisions.choice: Walltime pair goes in xtask's own tests (worktree_walltime, fallback_walltime, linked_worktree_walltime), calling walltime::read_jobs directly. The athena-cli test file maps walltime to these by name, as a stated deviation. Option (b), a subprocess, is rejected.
decisions.reason: xtask has no lib target and athena-cli does not depend on it; criterion 3 requires placement in xtask.

rejected.option: Run xtask as a subprocess from athena-cli
rejected.why: CARGO_BIN_EXE_xtask is unavailable outside the xtask package.

decisions.choice: land_pr tests live in gh.rs next to the existing Rig/FakeHost tests: worktree_land_pr and fallback_land_pr use distinct job ids (W-id in worktree, T-id in-tree). They call resolve(job_ref) with a runner that refuses every call. Worktree case: resolve succeeds for W-id and errors 'unknown job' for T-id. Fallback case: the reverse.
decisions.reason: Rig/FakeHost are cfg(test) in gh.rs and unreachable from integration tests; distinct ids show which record was read.

decisions.choice: Status, audit and forecast are shown by running the built athena binary on a scratch checkout with no records/ in the working tree. Worktree has job id W, in-tree has job id T. Status and audit output must contain W and not T; forecast must succeed (fake agent, offline). Auditor and other library readers return records directly and the test compares job ids.
decisions.reason: Distinct ids make the observed marker explicit.

rejected.option: Compare equal output to a reference checkout
rejected.why: Does not show which record was read.

decisions.choice: Scoring and forecasting closures (run.rs ~2392, reading.rs forecast loads) use the worktree whatever head is passed; documented in docs/decisions.md and tested with a head unlike the worktree tip.
decisions.reason: After cutover the branch tip is the only full history; criterion 6 requires documenting and testing.

rejected.why: Would score against frozen main records.

decisions.choice: records_reader_scan is scan(root: &Path) -> Vec<Hit> in xtask/src/main.rs, with an allow-list keyed by (file, function); it flags crate::store::Records::load( paths and ignores citation strings in steward.rs and work_decisions. Tests: planted read reported, real tree clean.

decisions.choice: Generate the athena-cli worktree_/fallback_ pairs by macro over a table sharing one fixture builder, for athena-cli-reachable readers only.

risks.mitigation: Only 'current' callers switch; without a worktree load_current equals load; run full cargo test --locked.

risks.mitigation: Fixture sets ATHENA_STATE_DIR to a tempdir, passes it to child processes, and asserts paths are under it.

risks.mitigation: Tests init their own repos in tempdirs.

demonstrations.method: Integration tests in records_branch_readers.rs, macro-generated worktree_<reader> for records_load_current, recordset_load_current, read_records, introspect_walks, scoring, forecasting, retry_carry, auditor, proposals, backtest, plus worktree_status and worktree_audit via the binary. Each plants job W in the worktree and T in-tree, and asserts W appears and T does not.
demonstrations.observes: All worktree_ tests pass, each asserting the worktree's job id and not the in-tree id.
demonstrations.fails_without: A reader still reading in-tree records/ or the passed head returns T and its worktree_ test fails.

demonstrations.method: Macro-generated fallback_<reader> tests for the same readers with no worktree; assert the in-tree T result equals the pre-change path (Records::load at head, read_records(root)).
demonstrations.observes: All fallback_ tests pass and return T, equal to the pre-change result.
demonstrations.fails_without: A reader that errors or returns empty without a worktree fails its fallback_ test.

demonstrations.method: xtask unit tests worktree_walltime and fallback_walltime (distinct ids) plus linked_worktree_walltime, which makes a repo, runs git worktree add for a linked checkout, and finds the records worktree via the common dir.
demonstrations.observes: Nonzero tests run; the three walltime tests pass; the worktree test returns W only, the fallback test returns T only.
demonstrations.fails_without: Reading <root>/.git or in-tree only fails the worktree and linked tests.

demonstrations.method: gh.rs tests worktree_land_pr and fallback_land_pr using Rig/FakeHost, distinct ids, resolve(job_ref) with a refusing runner.
demonstrations.observes: Worktree: resolve ok for W, 'unknown job' for T. Fallback: ok for T, 'unknown job' for W.
demonstrations.fails_without: A land_pr still reading the in-tree load resolves T under the worktree and the test fails.

demonstrations.method: Test scratch_checkout runs the built athena (CARGO_BIN_EXE_athena) status, audit and a forecast (fake agent, offline) on a scratch checkout with no records/ in its tree, with ATHENA_STATE_DIR set to a tempdir holding the worktree (W) and in-tree records (T).
demonstrations.observes: All exit 0; status and audit stdout contain W and not T.
demonstrations.fails_without: A reader needing working-tree records/ fails or prints T/empty.

demonstrations.method: The fixture creates the records worktree under a tempdir state dir and asserts the path is under it; scoring_ignores_passed_head passes a head unlike the worktree tip and asserts the worktree's results; docs/decisions.md records the rule.
demonstrations.observes: Test passes; nothing is created under the real state root; decision text present in the diff.
demonstrations.fails_without: A closure honouring the passed head returns main's records and the test fails.

demonstrations.method: xtask tests records_reader_scan_reports_planted_read (including a crate::store::Records::load( path), records_reader_scan_ignores_citations (steward.rs and work_decisions strings), and records_reader_scan_real_tree_clean (call-site allow-list).
demonstrations.observes: At least 3 tests ran and passed (nonzero).
demonstrations.fails_without: A scan ignoring planted reads fails the planted-read test.
